text: Ukhamarus aka jan walt'äw askichañax ch'amawa, apnaqkay fusión reactoranak lurirx walja mara mäkhipatatw uñjaskañäni.
eng_text: This, however, is a very hard problem to solve and will take many years before we see useful fusion reactors built.

text: Uka jiru awujax uka uma patxanx thayampitapat tuyti.
eng_text: The steel needle floats on top of the water because of surface tension.

text: Uma patxan kunatix kamachki moléculas ukanakampix katthapisipxiw maynit maynikama wali ch´amanpi juk´an jil thayat sipansa.
eng_text: Surface tension happens because the water molecules at the surface of the water are strongly attracted to each other more than they are to the air molecules above them.

text: Uman mulikulanakapax jan uñjkay umarux tukuyi, ukhamat uka awujas uka uma patxanx tuytarakispa.
eng_text: The water molecules make an invisible skin on the water’s surface that allows things like the needle to float on top of the water.

text: Chhullunkhan jalnaqañ jichha patinax pä thiyaniwa, uka pä thiya taypinx mä p'iyaw utji. Uka pä thiyampix chhullunkhankañax juk'amp khusawa, alt'atäkasas yamakis ukhamarakiwa.
eng_text: The blade on a modern ice skate has a double edge with a concave hollow between them. The two edges allow for a better grasp of the ice, even when tilted.

text: Quqanakan laphinakapakis aynachaxax ukanakasti wali sum niya muruqtam sasismachjitawa, kunasatix maysarus q´imt´a siskis ukhas q´imt´asikirakiwa khawsa tuqirusa.
eng_text: Because the bottom of the blade is slightly curved, as the blade tilts to one side or the other, the edge which is in contact with the ice also curves.

text: Akax khunu llust'ir jaqiruw muytayi, llust'añ wiskhutim altix kupi tuqirux, llust'ir jaqix muytix kupi tuqiruraki, llust'ir wiskhutim ch'iqa tuqir alt'ixa, llust'ir jaqis ch'iqa tuqirurakiw muytaraki.
eng_text: This causes the skater to turn. If the skates tilt to the right, the skater turns right, if the skates tilt to the left, the skater turns left.

text: Nayrir inirjiy ukar kutañatakixa, kawkir qhanatï apaqatak uka inirjiyx thuqhañamawa.
eng_text: To return to their previous energy level, they must get rid of the extra energy they got from the light.

text: Lurapxiwa mä jisk'a qhana apantasa satarakiw “phutuna”.
eng_text: They do this by emitting a tiny particle of light called a "photon".

text: Akarux yatxatatanakax “amanut lurat junt'u ratyashuna” sutimpiw uñt'apxi, kunalaykutix atumunakax qhanampiw p'arxtayata, ukhamat ukha qhanax phutun ukaniñapataki, ukat uka qhanaw ratyashunanixa.
eng_text: Scientists call this process "stimulated emission of radiation" because the atoms are stimulated by the bright light, causing the emission of a photon of light, and light is a type of radiation.

text: Jutir jamuqax kunjams atumunakax phutunanak uñstayi ukxatawa. Qhanpachanxa, uka phutunanakax uka jamuqanakanx wali wali jisk'anakakipuniwa.
eng_text: The next picture shows the atoms emitting photons. Of course, in reality photons are a lot smaller than those in the picture.

text: Phutunanakax wali jan uñjkan jisk'anakarakikiwa, uka atumunak sipanxa!
eng_text: Photons are even smaller than the stuff that makes up atoms!

text: Waranqh pachanak mäkiptipanx uka lusa qhanan jisk'a ch'ankhapax phichhantasiwa, ukhamat uka lusa qhanax jan aqtxiti.
eng_text: After hundreds of hours of operation the filament in the bulb eventually burns out and the light bulb no longer works.

text: Lusa qhana ukanakax tukakipt´awi ukanak munapxaraki, kunasatir turkakipt´aski lusa qhananakax wali k´acham turkakipt´añawa.
eng_text: The light bulb then needs replacing. It is necessary to be careful in replacing the light bulb.

text: Nayraqatxa, uka lusa askichañtakixa jiwt'ayatañapawa, jan ukasti kawlix janiw apthapitañpakiti.
eng_text: First, the switch for the light fixture needs to be turned off or the cable disconnected.

text: Akatwa uka illapakux uka sukit manqhanx utji, ukhamarak kawkiwjatix mitalak ukawjas jan llamkt'añjamawa, ukhamatix jumax uka sukit manqha llamkt'asmax q'al thixthapiristamxa, ukhamatwa uka sukit manqhas jan ukax jiruwjas pachpakiskiwa.
eng_text: This is because electricity flowing into the socket where the metallic part of bulb sits can give you a severe electric shock if you touch the inside of the socket or the metal base of the bulb while it is still partly in the socket.

text: Lluqux wali wakiskirit janchin wila jalañanx uñt'atawa, ukapachpaw wilxa jalsuyi.
eng_text: The major organ of the circulatory system is the heart, which pumps the blood.

text: Wilax uka wila sirkanakanjamaw lluqutpach mistsuwayi, ukatx winanakanjamarakiw kutt'ani. Ukat uka wali jisk'a tuqunakax kapilaris sutininakawa.
eng_text: Blood goes away from the heart in tubes called arteries and comes back to the heart in tubes called veins. The smallest tubes are called capillaries.

text: Tirisiratup ukan lakanakapax kuna llaqanaks manq'xapxakisapanawa, ukhamarus jach'a thuru llaqanaka ukhamarak saphinaka.
eng_text: A triceratops' teeth would have been able to crush not only leaves but even very tough branches and roots.

text: Triceratopsax sikatanakw manq'äna sasaw yaqhip yatxatirix sapxi, uka kasta alinakax cretáciconx waljaw utjäna.
eng_text: Some scientists think Triceratops ate cycads, which are a type of plant that was common in the Cretaceous.

text: Quqanakax jisk'a palmiranakarjam uñtatawa, mä kurunani ukatx laphinakapax chhukstatakamakiwa.
eng_text: These plants look like a small palm tree with a crown of sharp, spiky leaves.

text: Mayni triceratops ukax janïr tun manq'antakasinx chhuruñapampix laphinak wikharaspanxa.
eng_text: A Triceratops could have used its strong beak to strip off the leaves before eating the trunk.

text: Yaqhip yatxatatanakatakix aka quqanakax jiwayaspawa, ukatx janiw tinusawryunakax janiw manq'apkaspati, ukampirus pirisusu yaqhip uyuwanakax manq'asipkakispawa ak llaqanaka, ukjamarak (tinusawryunakat jutatanaka) jiwayir achunaksa Lurur uñtata.
eng_text: Other scientists argue that these plants are very poisonous so it is unlikely that any dinosaur ate them, even though today the sloth and other animals like the parrot (a descendant of the dinosaurs) can eat poisonous leaves or fruit.

text: Kunjams uka gravedad ukax chumajar wayusitaspa? Supirphisyi ukaniristxa, Uraqin qhiparkt ukats juk'akiw qhipariristxa.
eng_text: How would Io's gravity pull on me? If you stood on the surface of Io, you would weigh less than you do on Earth.

text: Mä jaqiti 200 liwara (90kg) pisaspa ukhax Uraqinx 36 liwra (16kg) ukharak pisaspaxa. Ukhamasti jumanw jilaspaxa.
eng_text: A person who weighs 200 pounds (90kg) on Earth would weigh about 36 pounds (16kg) on Io. So the gravity, of course, pulls less on you.

text: Intixa janiw aka uraqjamakiti, aka uraqinx sarnaqasmawa, ukampis janiw aka intix ukhamakiti. Intix ancha qhatirawa.
eng_text: The Sun doesn't have a crust like the Earth that you can stand on. The whole Sun is made out of gases, fire, and plasma.

text: Willkat jithiqtki ukhax wapurax ukax juch'usaptiwa.
eng_text: The gas becomes thinner as you go farther from the center of the Sun.

text: Willka tatar uñtktan ukjax patankki uka chiqw uñjtan, uka chiqax qhana muruq'u satawa, ukax “qhana muruq'u” sañawa saraksnawa.
eng_text: The outer-part we see when we look at the Sun is called the photosphere, which means "ball of light".

text: Niya kimsa waranq maratx, 1610, Galileo Galilei, laqamp yatxatir Italia jaqiw Urürx laqamp uñch'ukiñamp uñjatayna, phaxsis kikipaw mayjt'i sataynawa.
eng_text: About three thousand years later, in 1610, Italian astronomer Galileo Galilei used a telescope to observe that Venus has phases, just as the moon does.

text: Winus uraqin pachanakapax mä maysaxsun (jan ukax phaxsina) inti qhanar uñtatakix ukhax qhantiwa. Winusan saranakapax Copernicus ukan amuyunakaparjamax intiruw uraqinakax muyti.
eng_text: Phases happen because only the side of Venus (or of the Moon) facing the Sun is lighted. The phases of Venus supported the theory of Copernicus that the planets go around the Sun.

text: Ukatatx, mä qawqha mara qhipatx, 1639 maranx, mä Inglaterra laqamp yatxatiriw Urüru jithir uñjawiyi, jupax Jeremiah Horrocks satänwa.
eng_text: Then, a few years later in 1639, an English astronomer named Jeremiah Horrocks observed a transit of Venus.

text: Inglaterra markax samarañ jaypachapunix jikxatatayna kunalaykutix Danelaw mayamp markar iyawsayatäyna.
eng_text: England had experienced a long period of peace after the reconquest of the Danelaw.

text: Ukhamarus, 991 maranx, Ethelredax vikingo wampunakampiw ch'axwawiyi, Guthruman patak mara nayra walja wampunakapats jilänwa.
eng_text: However in 991 Ethelred was faced with a Viking fleet larger than any since Guthrum's a century earlier.

text: Aka phlutax Olaf Trygvasson, tanis ukat markap kutiqayañ munir nuruyju jupan apatänwa.
eng_text: This fleet was led by Olaf Trygvasson, a Norwegian with ambitions to reclaim his country from Danish domination.

text: Qalltkasax ch'axwäwin atipayasiwiyapxiwa, ukatatx Ethelredax Olafampiw mä amtar puriwiyi, jupax Noruegaruw uka markapan atipaniñatak kutt'awiyi, ukanx atiparakïn janirakiwa.
eng_text: After initial military setbacks, Ethelred was able to agree to terms with Olaf, who returned to Norway to try to gain his kingdom with mixed success.

text: Hangeul arunakax uka sapakiw jaqinakatak uñstayatäna. Arunakax 1444ni maran uñstayatawa kunapachatix rey Sejong (1418 - 1450) uka maranakan apnaqkan ukja.
eng_text: Hangeul is the only purposely invented alphabet in popular daily use. The alphabet was invented in 1444 during the reign of King Sejong (1418 – 1450).

text: Joseon riyinak taypinx Sejong riyiw payïr riyixa, wali yäqat riyinak taypinkarakiwa.
eng_text: King Sejong was the fourth king of the Joseon Dynasty and is one of the most highly regarded.

text: Nayraqatx Hangeul Hunmin Jeongeum sasaw qillqanakx sutichawiyi, ukax “Jaqir yatichañ chiqpach arsutanaka” sañ munaraki.
eng_text: He originally named the Hangeul alphabet Hunmin Jeongeum, which means "the correct sounds for the instruction of the people".

text: Sánscriton uñstatapatx kunayman amuyuw utji. Inti jalanttuqutw Indiarux ariy jaqinakax purinipxi, jupanakaw arupamp purinipxi sasaw mä amuyux utjaraki.
eng_text: There are many theories to how Sanskrit came into existence. One of them is about an Aryan migration from the west into India who brought their language with them.

text: Sancrito uka arux nayra aruwa ukatx Europan Latin arux arsuski ukampix janiw kipkakiti.
eng_text: Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe.

text: Nayrir uraqpachan uñt'at pankax SansKrit ukan qillqatanwa. Upanishands, uñakipatatxa jupañakiw Sanskrit ukax jirarkiya utjatapatx chhaqtawayi.
eng_text: The earliest known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the compilation of Upanishads, Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy.

text: Sanskritu arux wali ch'amtayi aruwa, ch'iyar janchinin wakiskir arunakapar ch'amanchañatakiwa, niyas latin aru kipka Frances ukat Ispañull arunakar sarantayiri.
eng_text: Sanskrit is a very complex and rich language, which has served to be the source for many modern Indian languages, just like Latin is the source for European languages like French and Spanish.

text: Franciat ch'axwañ tukuyatatx, Alemaniax Gran Bretaña wat'ar ch'amamp mantañatakiw wakt'ayasiñ qalltawiyi.
eng_text: With the battle for France over, Germany began to get ready to invade the island of Britain.

text: Alimananakax “Operation Sealion” sasin sutichapxatayna. Gran Bretaña uksankir palla pallanakan armamintunakap ukhamarak nuwasiñanakapx Dunkirk tuqit sarkxasaw chhaqhayawayapxatayna, ukhat palla pallanakax janiw wali ch'amanipkanati.
eng_text: Germany code-named the attack “Operation Sealion”. Most of the British Army's heavy weapons and supplies had been lost when it evacuated from Dunkirk, so the army was fairly weak.

text: Royal Navyx Alemania lamar quta palla pallanakat (“Kriegsmarine”) sipans juk'amp ch'amanikïskänwa, Mancha k'ullk'u qutäm purinir kuna ñanqhachir wampunaks tukjaspänwa.
eng_text: But the Royal Navy was still much stronger than the German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) and could have destroyed any invasion fleet sent across the English Channel.

text: Ukhamarus, wali juk'a Royal Navy wampukiw ch'amamp mantañ munatäkän uka chiqanakar puriñ yatipxäna, Alemania awiyunanakaw umar chhaqhtayistaspa sasaw wampu p'iqichirinakax axsarayasipxäna.
eng_text: However, very few Royal Navy ships were based near the likely invasion routes as the admirals were afraid they would be sunk by German air attack.

text: Italian jach´a amtawipxata jichhax qalltañani. Italiaxa Alemania ukhamaraki Japonan jisk´iri jilaru uñt´atanawa.
eng_text: Let's start with an explanation about Italy's plans. Italy was mainly the "little brother" of Germany and Japan.

text: Pallapallanakas janiw ch´amanipkanti, ukampirus machaq pusi warkunak lurst´asipxarakitayna, janir uka jach´a nuwasin qalltkasaxa.
eng_text: It had a weaker army and a weaker navy, although they had just built four new ships right before the beginning of the war.

text: Italya markan amtapax Africa markanar purintañanawa. Uka markanak katuntasiña, ukhamat jupanakax walja jach'a qutu pallapallanak munapxatayna, ukhamat aka pallapallanakax Mar Mediterráneo ukaran Africa markarux munay jan mun mantantapxatayna.
eng_text: Italy's main goals were African countries. To capture those countries, they would need to have a troop launching pad, so as troops could sail across the Mediterranean Sea and invade Africa.

text: Ukatakixa, Egipto markanx warkunak jaytawayxapxanwa. Ukampirus aka luratanakatxa, ch'amañchat Italianunakax janiw kus lurapxañapäkanti.
eng_text: For that, they had to get rid of British bases and ships in Egypt. Besides those actions, Italy's battleships were not supposed to do anything else.

text: Jichhax Japunataki, Japon markax qutataypinkir markänwa, niyas Gran Bretañaruñtata.
eng_text: Now for Japan. Japan was an island country, just like Britain.

text: Suwmarinunakax uma manqha sarañataki ukat jaya pacha ukankañatak lurat wampunakawa.
eng_text: Submarines are ships designed to travel underwater, and remain there for an extended amount of time.

text: Suwmarinunakax Primera Guerra Mundial ukat Segunda Guerra Mundial ukanakan apnaqasiwayi. Uka pachanx wali k'achänwa ukat jak'arukiw illapt'äna.
eng_text: Submarines were used in World War I and World War II. Back then they were very slow and had a very limited shooting range.

text: Ch'axwäw qalltanx qutanam sarapxirïna, ukampis ratar lurañ qalltasiwayi ukat juk’amp kusäxipanx suwmarinunakax jan uñjayasiñatakix muna jan munaw uma manqhanam sarxapxi.
eng_text: In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen.

text: Uma manqhän saranaqir aleman jupanakax U-Boats. satawa. Aleman jupanakax uma manqhan sarnaqañatakix wali kust'atapxiwa.
eng_text: German submarines were called U-Boats. The Germans were very good at navigating and operating their submarines.

text: Suwmarinukan aski jikxatawiparjamaxa, ch'axwaw qhipatax Alemananakax janis jupanakan utjirinipkaspa ukhamawa.
eng_text: Because of their success with submarines, after the war Germans aren't trusted to have many of them.

text: Jisa! King Tutankhamun, yaqhippachanakax “King Tut” sutichapxi, jan ukasti “The Boy King”, jupax wali uñt'at khaysa Ijiptun riyipxam jichhapachan uñt'atawa.
eng_text: Yes! King Tutankhamun, sometimes referred to as "King Tut" or "The Boy King", is one of the most well known ancient Egyptian kings in modern times.

text: Nayra jakawinakanx janiw uñt´askiti ukhamarak janiw qillqatas uñstkarakiti kuna nayra laphinakan qillqatanakansa.
eng_text: Interestingly, he was not considered to be very important in ancient times and was not recorded on most ancient king lists.

text: Ukampirusa, 1922 maran amay imatap jikxatäwix mä amtaskay uruw tukünxa.
eng_text: However, the discovery of his tomb in 1922 made him a celebrity. While many tombs of the past were robbed, this tomb was left virtually undisturbed.

text: Walja Tutankhamu ukamp imanatatanakasti wali sumarakiw imasitäna, ukanx uñstarakiwa walja amparanakamp jisk´a k´achanak kunayman qalanakat luratanaka ukhamarak qurit kunanaka.
eng_text: Most of the items buried with Tutankhamun have been well preserved, including thousands of artefacts made from precious metals and rare stones.

text: Uka Asirian llanta rayrunak uñstayatanakax wali jank'ak sarañapatakitaynawa, ukhamat sultarunakar awtunakar atipjañataki.
eng_text: The invention of spoke wheels made Assyrian chariots lighter, faster, and better prepared to outrun soldiers and other chariots.

text: Philichanakax sultarun suma jirut lurat isinakaparux pastarakispawa.1000 B.C. Asiriws sultarunakaw kawallut laxatataw mantapxarakitayna.
eng_text: Arrows from their deadly crossbows could penetrate the armor of rival soldiers. About 1000 B.C., the Assyrians introduced the first cavalry.

text: Mä kawlliriyax mä ijirsituw qaqilump ch'axwiri. Qunuñ karunax janïraw machaqat uñstayatakataynati, kunalaykutix kawalliriya Asiria ukax qaqilunakapampiw ch'axwawayatayna.
eng_text: A cavalry is an army that fights on horseback. The saddle had not yet been invented, so the Assyrian cavalry fought on the bare backs of their horses.

text: Walja pulitikus sintifikus ukat artistas jupanakaruw uñt'tana. Inas wali uñt'atax aka saranx Homero jupachispa. Jaya mara chapart'iri, jupax litiratura griega ukxa paywa qillqt'atayana: Iliada ukatx Odisea ukanakaw qillqt'atayna.
eng_text: We know many Greek politicians, scientists, and artists. Possibly the most known person of this culture is Homer, the legendary blind poet, who composed two masterpieces of Greek literature: the poems Iliad and Odyssey.

text: Sófocles ukjamarak Aristófanes jupanakax uñit'awinakat qillqirinakakikiswa ukampis uka qillqatanakapax uraqpachanx wali wakiskiriwa.
eng_text: Sophocles and Aristophanes are still popular playwrights and their plays are considered to be among the greatest works of world literature.

text: Yaqha suma jaqi uñt´ata ukasti Pitágoras ukarakiwa, jupasti uñt´atarakiwa kuna laykutix jupax mä teorema uñanstayawaraki kimsa uñtasiwita triangulo uksa tuqita.
eng_text: Another famous Greek is a mathematician Pythagoras, mostly known for his famous theorem about relations of the sides of right triangles.

text: Aka India arutxa utjiwa wali qillqatanaka. Ukhamarakiw aka laxrax payiri ukhamaraki pusiri wali arusita laxrawa aka urakinxa.
eng_text: There are varying estimates for how many people speak Hindi. It is estimated to be between the second and fourth most commonly spoken language in the world.

text: Qawqhanipunis uka aru arsurix ukax mayj mayjaspawa, janiw pachpakaspati, ukhamarak uka jakthapiwinx mayj mayj arusirinakaw jakthapiñaspa.
eng_text: The number of native speakers varies depending on whether or not very closely related dialects are counted.

text: 340 waranq waranq jaqit 500 waranq waranq jaqikamaw uka arx arsupxaspa, khithinakati uka arx amuyapki jupanakampach jakhthapitax 800 waranq waranq jaqïspawa sasaw tantiyapxi.
eng_text: Estimates range from 340 million to 500 million speakers, and as many as 800 million people can understand the language.

text: Jindi arun ukhamarak Urtu arun arunakapax niy pachpakiwa, ukhamarus qillqapax mayjawa; sapür aruskipäwinakanxa, arsurinakapax paypach arx jan kunak arsutanakx amuyapxaspa.
eng_text: Hindi and Urdu are similar in vocabulary but different in script; in everyday conversations, speakers of both languages can usually understand each other.

text: XV patak mara ukjanakax Estonia alayax Alemanian saräwipamp wali samantatänwa.
eng_text: Around the 15th century, northern Estonia was under great cultural influence of Germany.

text: Yaqhipanak monjes alemanes ukanakax tatitur jak´achasiñ munapxanxa, ukhamat qallantayawapxatayna laxra Estonio uka qilqa aru.
eng_text: Some German monks wanted to bring God closer to the native people, so they invented the Estonian literal language.

text: Alfabeto aleman ukarjamaw apnaqasi ukatx “Õ/õ” uka qillqanakampiw yapxatasi.
eng_text: It was based on the German alphabet and one character "Õ/õ" was added.

text: Kunjamatix pachanakax mäkiptawayxi, walja walja mayachthapit aliman arunakapuniw mayt'asitatäna. Ukax Amuy Pacha qalltataynawa.
eng_text: As time passed, many words that were borrowed from German coalesced. This was the beginning of enlightenment.

text: Nayrapacharjamax uka trunu katuqirix chiqak pallapallanak taypir iskuyl tukuyasin manti.
eng_text: Traditionally, the heir to the throne would go straight into the military after finishing school.

text: Maysatxa, Charlesax Trinity jach'a yatiqañ utaruw saratayna, Cambridge ukan antropologíamp arkiyulujiyamp yatiqarakitayna, ukat qhiparusti nayra sarnaqäwinakata, ukhamat 2:2 (wali juk'a chanik apsusitayna(.
eng_text: However, Charles went to university at Trinity College, Cambridge where he studied Anthropology and Archaeology, and later History, earning a 2:2 (a lower second class degree).

text: Britanica markanx Charles jupaw nayraqatx titul katuqasitayna.
eng_text: Charles was the first member of the British Royal Family to be awarded a degree.

text: Turquía europeax (Tracian inti jalsupa jan ukax Balcanes wit’un Rumelia) markat 3% ukjamp mayachi.
eng_text: European Turkey (eastern Thrace or Rumelia in the Balkan peninsula) includes 3% of the country.

text: Turquía uka markasti mä waranq suxta patak 1, 600 kilómetros ukcha sayt'urakiwa sayt´utsa (mä waranq millas- 1, 000) ukhamark 800 kilómetros ukch´a thururakiwa thurutsa (phisqa patak millanaka-500).
eng_text: The territory of Turkey is more than 1,600 kilometres (1,000 mi) long and 800 km (500 mi) wide, with a roughly rectangular shape.

text: Turkiya marka uraqimp qutanakapampix 783, 562 kilómetros cuadrado jach'awa (300, 948 milla cuadrada ukhama), ukatx 755, 688 kilómetro cuadradow (291, 773 milla cuadrada ukhama) Inti jalantat ch'iqatuq Asia uraqinki, 23, 764 kilómetro cuadradow (9, 174 milla cuadrada ukhama) Iwrupankaraki.
eng_text: Turkey's area, including lakes, occupies 783,562 square kilometres (300,948 sq mi), of which 755,688 square kilometres (291,773 sq mi) are in south west Asia and 23,764 square kilometres (9,174 sq mi) in Europe.

text: Turkiya marka uraqix aka uraqpachanx 37ïr jach'a markawa, uka markax Pharansya Metropolitan marka ukat Reyno Unidon apthapsnan ukch'a markawa.
eng_text: Turkey's area makes it the world's 37th-largest country, and is about the size of Metropolitan France and the United Kingdom combined.

text: Lamar qutanakax kimsatutw Turkiya uraqx muyukipapxi: Egeo Lamar Qutax Inti jalanttuqunkiwa, Ch'iyara Lamar Qutax ch'iqatuquna, Mediterraneo Lamar Qutarak kupituquna.
eng_text: Turkey is encircled by seas on three sides: the Aegean Sea to the west, the Black Sea to the north and the Mediterranean Sea to the south.

text: Luxemburgo markax wali nayra lurawinakaniwa ukätx yaqhaqtatapäx 1839ni uka maratakiwa.
eng_text: Luxembourg has a long history but its independence dates from 1839.

text: Jichhürunakanxa Belgium ukanx yaqhipawjanakapax Luxembourg ukawjankiritaynawa, khaya 1830 uka maranakan Belga ch'axwawinakampiw Belga ukham tukuniwayxaraki.
eng_text: Present-day parts of Belgium were part of Luxembourg in the past but became Belgian after the 1830s Belgian Revolution.

eng_text: The temple of Artemis at Ephesus was destroyed on July 21, 356 BCE in an act of arson committed by Herostratus.

eng_text: Make sure your hand is as relaxed as possible while still hitting all the notes correctly - also try not to make much extraneous motion with your fingers.

text: Misticismo ukax yaqha yupaychawinakatx mayjaspawa, luratanakarjamax nayatakix amyujanx mayakiwa, sumankaña, sumpach uñakipaña, k'uchisiñanaka ukjamjamaw uka tuqi yupaychawinxa.
eng_text: Mysticism can be distinguished from other forms of religious belief and worship by its emphasis on the direct personal experience of a unique state of consciousness, particularly those of a peaceful, insightful, blissful, or even ecstatic character.

text: Sijismu ukax suwkuntininti intyun iyawsäwipawa. Intü saräw taypin t’aqxtañ utjatapat XV patak maran Punjab uksan uñstawayi.
eng_text: Sikhism is a religion from the Indian sub-continent. It originated in the Punjab region during the 15th century from a sectarian split within the Hindu tradition.

text: Intuyismut iyawsäwipax jithiqtatawa saw sijs jupanakax sawpxi, ukampis kawkjats juti ukat intuwis saräwinak uñt’apxiwa.

eng_text: Sikhs call their religion Gurmat, which is Punjabi for "way of the guru". The guru is a fundamental aspect of all Indian religions but in Sikhism has taken on an importance that forms the core of Sikh beliefs.

text: Rilijyun ukax XV ukhanaw Guru Nanak (1469-1539) maran ut'ayatawa. Yaqha gurus jupanakas arkatanipxarakiwa.

eng_text: Bowen Island is a popular day trip or weekend excursion offering kayaking, hiking, shops, restaurants, and more.

eng_text: For those who enjoy outdoor activities, a trek up the Sea to Sky corridor is essential.

eng_text: Whistler (1.5 hour drive from Vancouver) is expensive but well-known because of the 2010 Winter Olympics.

eng_text: In the winter, enjoy some of the best skiing in North America, and in the summer try some authentic mountain biking.

eng_text: With the same time zone as Hawaii, the islands are sometimes thought of as "Hawaii down under".

eng_text: Though smaller, it reminds some elderly visitors of Hawaii before statehood without all the large tourist hotels and other development.

eng_text: The Cook Islands do not have any cities but are composed of 15 different islands. The main ones are Rarotonga and Aitutaki.

eng_text: At the top end, B&Bs obviously compete mainly on two main things: bedding and breakfast.

eng_text: Setting up a tent on private property or in a town of any size can easily attract unwanted attention.

eng_text: Some hotels have a heritage from the golden age of steam railways and ocean liners; before the Second World War, in the 19th or early 20th centuries.

eng_text: The old fashioned fittings, the lack of the latest amenities, and a certain graceful agedness are also part of their character.

eng_text: While they are usually privately owned, they sometimes accommodate visiting heads of state and other dignitaries.

eng_text: Couchsurfing was founded in January 2004 after computer programmer Casey Fenton found a cheap flight to Iceland but did not have a place to stay.

eng_text: The city of Beijing in China will be the host city of the Olympic Winter Games in 2022, which will make it the first city to have hosted both the summer and winter Olympics.

eng_text: Drink alcoholic drinks with moderation. Alcohol affects everyone differently, and knowing your limit is very important.

eng_text: For a day hike along an easy trail little preparations are needed, and any moderately fit person can enjoy them.

eng_text: Families with small children may need more preparations, but a day outdoors is easily possible even with babies and pre-school children.

text: Kuna chiqar janir sarkasas, sarkta ukjas kunaymanatw amuykipt'asiñama.
eng_text: There are many things you have to take into consideration before and when you travel somewhere.

eng_text: When you travel, expect things not to be like they are "back home". Manners, laws, food, traffic, lodging, standards, language and so on will to some extent differ from where you live.

eng_text: This is something you always need to keep in mind, to avoid disappointment or perhaps even distaste over local ways to do things.

text: 19 patak maranakatpachw yaqha chiqar saririnakar irpañ utanakax utji. Saririnakax uraqimp saräwinakamp arunakamp pisin jakasir markanakampx uñt'xaspawa, ukhamarus juk'amp uñt'añatakix irpirinïñaw khusaraki.
eng_text: Travel agencies have been around since the 19th century. A travel agent is usually a good option for a journey which extends beyond a traveller's previous experience of nature, culture, language or low-income countries.

text: Jilpach ajinsyanakaw reservas regulares ukanak katuqañatakix iyawsapxanxa, qullqinak jikxatañataki.
eng_text: Although most agencies are willing to take on most regular bookings, many agents specialise in particular types of travel, budget ranges or destinations.

text: Wali askiniw kunjamtix maynïr wakichirix wakichiski, ukham wakichayxañaxa.
eng_text: It can be better to use an agent who frequently books similar trips to yours.

text: Irnaqirin ch'usasiwitak juk'a chaninik uñt'ayki ukanak uñjt'am, ukax llikan jan ukax wintanan apkatataspawa.
eng_text: Take a look at what trips the agent is promoting, whether on a website or in a shop window.

eng_text: If you want to see the world on the cheap, for necessity, lifestyle or challenge, there are some ways to do that.

text: Qalltanxa, akax pä t'aqaruw t'aqxti: Paypachaspaw kunawsatix ch'usaskt jan ukax qullq jan sint willtañataki. Ukhamat aka qillqatax qhip qhipawa.
eng_text: Basically, they fall into two categories: Either work while you travel or try and limit your expenses. This article is focused on the latter.

text: Khitinakatix suma taqikunxan jakañ jaqtañ munxapxixa, amuyatatx taqi qullqi willtawinakax janiw utjxaspati, uka jan qullqimp sarnaqañ uñjam.
eng_text: For those willing to sacrifice comfort, time and predictability to push expenses down close to zero, see minimum budget travel.

eng_text: The advice assumes that travellers do not steal, trespass, participate in the illegal market, beg, or otherwise exploit other people for their own gain.

eng_text: It's compacted snow with crevasses filled in and marked by flags. It can only be traveled by specialized tractors, hauling sleds with fuel and supplies.

eng_text: The most common cause for accidents in winter is slippery roads, pavements (sidewalks) and especially steps.

eng_text: At a minimum, you need footwear with suitable soles. Summer shoes are usually very slippery on ice and snow, even some winter boots are deficient.

eng_text: Some boots have studs and there is studded add-on equipment for slippery conditions, suitable for most shoes and boots, for the heels or heels and sole.

eng_text: Heels should be low and wide. Sand, gravel or salt (calcium chloride) is often scattered on roads or paths to improve traction.

eng_text: The problem is that snow is sticky, so it needs some triggering to come down, and some snow coming down can be the triggering event for the rest.

eng_text: Personal VPN (virtual private network) providers are an excellent way of circumventing both political censorship and commercial IP-geofiltering.

eng_text: They normally offer higher bandwidth and better quality of service. They are encrypted and thus harder to spy on.

eng_text: The media companies routinely lie about the purpose of this, claiming that it is to "prevent piracy".

eng_text: In fact, region codes have absolutely no effect on illegal copying; a bit-for-bit copy of a disk will play just fine on any device where the original will.

eng_text: The actual purpose is to give those companies more control over their markets; it's all about money spinning.

eng_text: Because calls are routed over the Internet, you do not need to use a phone company located where you live or where you travel.

eng_text: There is also no requirement that you obtain a local number from the community in which you live; you can obtain a satellite Internet connection in the wilds of Chicken, Alaska and select a number which claims you're in sunny Arizona.

eng_text: Often, you have to buy a global number separately that allows PSTN phones to call you. Where the number is from makes a difference for people calling you.

text: Uñjkay jaqukipir aplikashunanaka - aka aplikashunanakaxa, juk'ampis justupach arut arur qillqatanak jaqukipirinakawa.
eng_text: Real-time text translator apps – applications that are capable of automatically translating whole segments of text from one language into another.

text: Aka kast jawsañ yänapirinakax anqa marka arunakw qillqatanakampit jakäwin utjki uka yaqha yänakampit yamakis jaqukipapxaspa, kunapachati jaqix uka qillqatanak jawsañapar uñacht'ayki ukjaw ukhama.
eng_text: Some of the applications in this category can even translate texts in foreign languages on signs or other objects in the real world when the user points the smartphone towards those objects.

text: Atamir jan ukasti jaqukipañ makinanakax walt'atapuniw jiltawayi, jichhax yaqhipachanakax wali yaqhippachanakast jan walrak (juk'ampis jan amuykaya), ukhamarus uñakipañ ukhawa, kunjamtix jan walpun taqikuns jaqukipasipkaspa.
eng_text: The translation engines have improved dramatically, and now often give more or less correct translations (and more seldom gibberish), but some care is due, as they still may have gotten it all wrong.

eng_text: One of the most prominent apps in this category is Google Translate, which allows offline translation after downloading the desired language data.

eng_text: If you don't have a data connection for your phone, or when it is out of range, their performance can be limited or unavailable.

eng_text: Every corner store is filled with a confusing array of pre-paid phone cards that can be used from pay phones or ordinary telephones.

eng_text: While most cards are good for calling anywhere, some specialise in providing favourable call rates to specific groups of countries.

eng_text: Access to these services is often through a toll-free telephone number that can be called from most phones without charge.

eng_text: Rules regarding regular photography also apply to video recording, possibly even more so.

eng_text: If using a drone, check well in advance as to what you are allowed to film and what permits or additional licensing are required.

eng_text: Flying a drone near an airport or over a crowd is almost always a bad idea, even if it's not illegal in your area.

eng_text: Nowadays air travel is only rarely booked directly through the airline without first searching and comparing prices.

eng_text: Sometimes the same flight can have vastly differing prices at various agregators and it pays to compare search results and to also look at the website of the airline itself before booking.

text: Yaqhip markar uñatatt'asir jan ukax qullqichir jank'ak sarañamatakix inas jan wisax munaskchiti, ukhamarus anqa markar yatiqir sarañax jayjpachatakiwa, janiw khayar uñatatt'asir sarañjamakïkiti.
eng_text: While you may not need a visa for short visits to certain countries as a tourist or for business, going there as an international student generally requires a longer stay than going there just as a casual tourist.

text: Taqpachsipans, kawkir jaqisay anqa tuqir mistuwaychini jaypachjamax ukanxchinixa nayraqat ukhamrjamaw yaqha wisa apst'asiñapawa.
eng_text: In general, staying in any foreign country for an extended period of time will require you to obtain a visa in advance.

eng_text: Student visas generally have different requirements and application procedures from normal tourist or business visas.

eng_text: For most countries, you will need an offer letter from the institution you wish to study at, and also evidence of funds to support yourself for at least the first year of your course.

eng_text: Check with the institution, as well as the immigration department for the country you wish to study in for detailed requirements.

text: Jumatix mä diplomatikustaxa, ukhamat yaqha jach'a kuntinintinakan irnaqaskstaxa, jumax paylläwit impuystunak payllañamaniwa.

eng_text: Income tax is structured differently in different countries, and the tax rates and brackets vary widely from one country to another.

eng_text: In some federal countries, such as the United States and Canada, income tax is levied both at the federal level and at the local level, so the rates and brackets can vary from region to region.

eng_text: While immigration check is usually absent or a formality when you arrive in your homeland, customs control can be a hassle.

eng_text: Make sure you know what you can and cannot bring in and declare anything over the legal limits.

eng_text: Living and volunteering in a foreign country is a great way to get to know a different culture, meet new people, learn about yourself, get a sense of perspective and even gain new skills.

eng_text: It can also be a good way to stretch a budget to allow a longer stay somewhere since many volunteer jobs provide room and board and a few pay a small salary.

text: Kunapachatix anatañawjanakar purt'atäni ukhax taqi kunas amuykayaniwa. Yatxatarakitaw kunjam mäki warkunakax jaltapxi uksa ukhamarak jupanakas yatitanakapx yatiyapxarakitämwa.
eng_text: Be assured that once you hit the marinas everything will be pretty obvious. You will meet other boat hitchhikers and they will share their information with you.

text: Jumax kunti lurañ yatktax uka yatiyawinak yatiyaskataxa, qutar mantaña uka akanak sarnaqanitax, yatex ukanak phiskhusa ukhamarak mina qhuya irnaqirinakamp arusiñ musasa ukhama.
eng_text: Basically you'll be putting up notices offering your help, pacing the docks, approaching people cleaning their yachts, trying to make contact with sailors in the bar, etc.

text: Taqinimp aruskipt´an yant´am. Ukat mä qhawqha pachanakatx taqiniw uñt'tam ukat uñist´ayapxarakitam kitirus thaqasta ukaru.
eng_text: Try to talk to as many people as possible. After a while everyone will know you and will give you hints as to which boat is looking for someone.

text: Kawkiritix iyawsatak uka awyuna chhijllt'añama.
eng_text: You should choose your Frequent Flyer airline in an alliance carefully.

text: Ukhamatix jumax uka wali sarnaqatam awyun kumpañiyanakamp mayacht'asiñ amuystaxa, sum sum kunjams yanapasipk uk amuyañamawa, ukatx walja kut pachp awyun kumpañiyan saririnak pachp mayacht'awinkasmawa.
eng_text: Although you may think it is intuitive to join the airline you fly most, you should be aware that privileges offered are often different and frequent flyer points may be more generous under a different airline in the same alliance.

text: Awyun kumpañiyanakax sakiñäni Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways & Turkish Airlines taqi ukanakax Aphrika markanakanx jupanakkamakixataynawa, ukhamat Aphrikanx aksa uksa jalnaqapxi ukhamat Europa kumpañiyanakarux jan jalt'asiyxapxataynati.
eng_text: Airlines such as Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways & Turkish Airlines have greatly expanded their services to Africa, and offer connections to many major African cities at competitive rates than other European airlines.

text: 2014 marat aksarux, Turkish Airlines ukankirinakax 39 chiqaruw 30 África markan puriwiyapxi.
eng_text: Turkish Airlines flies to 39 destinations in 30 African countries as of 2014.

text: Jumantix yaqha markanak uñjtir sarañatak pachamax utjaskchi, uñakipt´askarakismawa qhawqhaspachas chaninakapax khä África uksa jach´a markar puriñatakixa.
eng_text: If you have additional travel time, check to see how your total fare quote to Africa compares with a round-the-world fare.

text: Janipun armasimti, uka q'ipimax lunthatanakatakix munkayaspawa, ukhamarak irptirinakax wumwach sasin uñch'ukipxarakispawa.
eng_text: Don't forget to add in the extra costs of additional visas, departure taxes, ground transportation, etc. for all those places outside of Africa.

text: Jumatix aka uraq aynachtuqiwjan muytañ munstaxa, janiw walja awyunanakax sarnaqkiti, ukhamarak wali juk'anikiw jalnaqapxi, janiw lamar qutat yaqha qutakam saririnakax utjkiti.
eng_text: If you want to fly around the world completely in the Southern Hemisphere, the choice of flights and destinations is limited due to the lack of transoceanic routes.

text: Aynach Imisfiryu ukanx janiw kawknïr mayacht'asit awyunas kimsa lamar quta mäkiptañx atipkiti (Mayacht'asit awyunanakax janiw mäkiptañx atipkiti).
eng_text: No airline alliance covers all three ocean crossings in the Southern Hemisphere (and SkyTeam covers none of the crossings).

text: Ukampirusa, Star Alliance ukax taqpacharuw puri ukatx kawkirirukis jan purkixa Pacifico Sur, Santiago de Chile ukat Tahiti, LATAM Oneworld awyunawa.
eng_text: However, Star Alliance covers everything except the eastern South Pacific from Santiago de Chile to Tahiti, which is a LATAM Oneworld flight.

text: Aka awyunakax janiw uka mayakikiti, jumatix uka Pasiphik lamar quta ukat inti jalantawx Aynach Amirikan mäkiptañ munsta ukhaxa)
eng_text: This flight is not the only option if you want to skip the South Pacific and the west coast of South America. (see below)

text: Khaya 1994 maranx Arminya Nagorno-Karabakh markachirinakax khaysa Axerbaijan ukankirinakas Axeris ukatuqiw muwasipxatayna.
eng_text: In 1994, the ethnically Armenian Nagorno-Karabakh region of Azerbaijan waged war against the Azeris.

text: Yaqha markw uñst'ayawiyapxi, Armeniaw ukhamäñapatakix ch'amacht'awiyi. Ukhamarus janiw kuna utt'ayat markas uka markx iyawsawiyapkiti, janirakiw Armeniasa.
eng_text: With Armenian backing, a new republic was created. However, no established nation - not even Armenia - officially recognizes it.

text: Markat markakam uka chiqawjan Armeniamp Azerbaijamp uka lamar qutatuqit aruskipañax sarantaskakiwa.
eng_text: Diplomatic arguments over the region continue to mar relations between Armenia and Azerbaijan.

text: Distrito del Canal (ulantisa: Grachtengordel) ukax Binnenstad de Ámsterdamar muyuntki uka XVII patak maran uñt’at tistrituwa.
eng_text: The Canal District (Dutch: Grachtengordel) is the famous 17th-century district surrounding the Binnenstad of Amsterdam.

text: Taqi uka uraqpachaw Taqi Jaqinkirjam UNESCON uñt'ata, ukan utjki uka sarnaqäwimp saräwimp yaqha chiqan jan utjatapata, utanakax uka markanx taqit jila chaniniwa.
eng_text: The whole district is designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site for its unique cultural and historical value, and its property values are among the highest of the country.

text: Cinque Terre ukax Phisqha Uraqi sañw muni, Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza, Monterosso phisqha jisk'a markaw ukham uñt'ata, Italianw jikxatasi, Liguria uraqina.
eng_text: Cinque Terre, which means Five Lands, comprises the five small coastal villages of Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza and Monterosso located in the Italian region of Liguria.

text: UNESCOx Uraqpachan Yäqat Yänakan Sutinakap qillqantki ukankiw ukanakaxa.
eng_text: They are listed on the UNESCO World Heritage List.

text: Patak maranakanxa, jaqix kunayman takananak uraqxarux uñstayapxatayna, ukhamarak wali suma qutar uñxatañatak chiqawjanak lurapxatayna.
eng_text: Over the centuries, people have carefully built terraces on the rugged, steep landscape right up to the cliffs that overlook the sea.

text: Ma jach'a irnaqaw munapiyañax uñjañatjam pinti.Thakinaka, tirinanaka warkasanaka markanakar jikisiyi k'añaskunakas janiw jikjatañ anqatpach atpkiti.
eng_text: Part of its charm is the lack of visible corporate development. Paths, trains and boats connect the villages, and cars cannot reach them from the outside.

text: Belgica ukat Suisa markanx frances arux Francia markan frances arumpis janiw kipkakiti, mayjt'awinakaw utji.
eng_text: The varieties of French which are spoken in Belgium and Switzerland differ slightly from the French spoken in France, though they are similar enough to be mutually intelligible.

text: Nayan amuyawijanxa, kunakitix jakhurt´aw sarawixa khaya Bélgica uksa markanxa ukamarak Suiza uksa tuqinsa khitinakatix Frances arsurinakapki jupanakansti arunak pixthapiñarakiw utji, kuntix jupanakax arsupki janiw pachpakis Francia uksankirinakampixa, yaqha kastapuniwa arsuwinakapaxa.
eng_text: In particular, the numbering system in French-speaking Belgium and Switzerland has some slight peculiarities that are different from the French spoken in France, and the pronunciation of some words is slightly different.

text: Maysipanx taqi pharansis parlir Belganak ukhamarak Suisunakax yatiqañ utanakanx utt'at pharansis aru yatiqapxañanakapawa, ukhamatx jupanakax taqi kast arsut ukhamarak uka pharansis jakhunaks amuyapxaniwa.
eng_text: Nevertheless, all French-speaking Belgians and Swiss would have learned standard French in school, so they would be able to understand you even if you used the standard French numbering system.

text: Uraqpachanx aruntasiñax wali askipuniwa, aruntasiñax mä munasiñ uñicht'awiwa “Kamisaki”.
eng_text: In many parts of the world, waving is a friendly gesture, indicating "hello."

text: Jan ukasti Malasia rural markanakanxa yatitawa “jutam” wikumpiw aca janchi uksaruw luqt'asis uñanaqt'asipxi, inti jalsu markanakanxa kikiparakiw yatisipki.
eng_text: However, in Malaysia, at least among the Malays in rural areas, it means "come over," similar to the index finger bent toward the body, a gesture which is used in certain Western countries, and should be used only for that purpose.

text: Kikipas, ma britanikun España saririx pantaspaw ma arunta achjarampi (jaqi lanti aruntasiri) kut'aniñapatakis jawskaspaxa ukhama.
eng_text: Similarly, a British traveller in Spain may mistake a wave goodbye involving the palm facing the waver (rather than the person being waved at) as a gesture to come back.

text: Yanapt'ir arunakax, jaqin lurat arunakawa jan ukasti jasak yatiyasiñatakirakiw uñstayata markanakan suma aruskipasiñataki.
eng_text: Auxiliary languages are artificial or constructed languages created with the intent of facilitating communication between peoples who would otherwise have difficulty communicating.

text: Pharansis uksa laxratxa yaqhacht´atarakipxiwa, uka laxranakax dominantis ukhamarakiw unstjaraki kunasatix arusitaxi ukhanakaxa yaqha laxr arusktan ukhanakaxa.
eng_text: They are separate from lingua francas, which are natural or organic languages that become dominant for one reason or another as means of communication between speakers of other languages.

text: Lapak urunxa saririnakax q'al samktapxatayna umanakampi (yaqha yanakampisa).
eng_text: In the heat of the day, travelers can experience mirages that give the illusion of water (or other things).

text: Akax jan walispawa saririr lirphuqir arnaqaspa ukhaxa, inamayaw chamapsa imatap umsa tukjasispa.
eng_text: These can be dangerous if the traveler pursue the mirage, wasting precious energy and remaining water.

text: Uka wali junt'u manq'a jarintax arumkamax ch'ucht'aspawa. Iputirmyax ukax jan wali thuru isinakan isthapisiñawa.
eng_text: Even the hottest of deserts can become extremely cold at night. Hypothermia is a real risk without warm clothing.

text: Ch'umi uraqin jallu pach sarnaqañ amtät ukax jañunakatw amuyasiñama.
eng_text: In summer, especially, you'll need to watch out for mosquitoes if you decide to hike through the rainforest.

text: Ch’umi taypnam awtu apasksta, punkunak jist’arat mä qawqha k’atanaka ukat ukañkamax manqhar mantsta ukax jumamp chikaw ukar ch’uspinakax mantarakini.
eng_text: Even if you're driving through the subtropical rainforest, a few seconds with the doors open while you get inside the vehicle is enough time for mosquitoes to get in the vehicle with you.

text: Jamch'inakan usupa, jamach'inakan jurma usupa ukham uñt'atatarakiwa, jamach'inakar ukhamarak ñuñun uywanakaruw piykataspa.
eng_text: Bird flu, or more formally avian influenza, can infect both birds and mammals.

text: Phisqha waranqat juk'amp juk'a jaqin usuntatapaw yatisi, ukhamarus yaqhipax jiwxapxarakiwa.
eng_text: Fewer than a thousand cases have ever been reported in humans, but some of them have been fatal.

text: Jilpach jaqix uyunkir phuyun uywanakamp irnaq jupanakxatw ayti, ukampirus kawkirinakatix phuyun uywanakar uñjapk jupanakatakix jan walt'äwiw utji.
eng_text: Most have involved people who work with poultry, but there is also some risk to birdwatchers.

text: Noruega jakirinakax fiordos escarpados ukanakawa qhirwanwa kikip chillqa churapxi.
eng_text: Typical for Norway are steep fjords and valleys that suddenly give way to a high, more or less even plateau.

text: Aka pampanakax uñt´ataw “vidde” sasina ukax mä jach´a pampa, jan quqanakan uk sañrak muni.
eng_text: These plateaus are often referred to as "vidde" meaning a wide, open treeless space, a boundless expanse.

text: Rogaland ukat Agder uksanx “hei” sasin apnaqapxi ukax jan quqan ch'alla uraqi sañ muni.
eng_text: In Rogaland and Agder they are usually called "hei" meaning a treeless moorland often covered in heather.

text: Thuru chhullunt´at uma laram jach´a quta taypinx jithinaqiriwa jach´a qullut aynachaparu. Uka jach´ thur chhullunkhanakasti wal uraqx jist´artayiritaynawa, ukat uka jistjatanakax khunump imantatarak chhaqayatawa.
eng_text: The glaciers are not stable, but flow down the mountain. This will cause cracks, crevasses, which may be obscured by snow bridges.

text: Uka chhullunkhay patxanak kuywanakaxa jalaqtanisin q'al llupantaspawa.
eng_text: The walls and roofs of ice caves can collapse and cracks can get closed.

text: Uka khunu qull alay patanakanx wali jach'a khunu muruq'unakaw allisini, jalaqtani, ukhamat yaqhippachanakax t'isktas t'isktas thiya pampakam purinipxi.
eng_text: At the edge of glaciers huge blocks break loose, fall down and perhaps jump or roll farther from the edge.

text: Uñjir saririnakax juk'ampis ukapachan Indian awtipachan jilpachax sarapxi.
eng_text: The tourist season for the hill stations generally peaks during the Indian summer.

text: Ukhamipanxa, yaqha kast jiwanak ukjamarak munkañanakaniw jallu pachanxa, yaqhip pachax uka qullunakanx walipuniw khununti ukatx walja lurawinak utjay lluskhunaqañatakixa.
eng_text: However, they have a different kind of beauty and charm during winter, with many hill stations receiving healthy amounts of snow and offering activities such as skiing and snowboarding.

text: Yaqhip awyun kumpañiyanakakiw iraqt'at jiwañan chaniñchatakiwa, ukxa qhip qhipa pacharukiw jiwat apayxätam.
eng_text: Only a few airlines still offer bereavement fares, which slightly discount the cost of last-minute funeral travel.

text: Awyun kumpañiyanakatx akanakawa Air Canada, Delta Air, Lines, Lufthansa ukanakax Istarus Unirut jan ukasti Canada markat, WestJet saririnakawa.
eng_text: Airlines that offer these include Air Canada, Delta Air Lines, Lufthansa for flights originating from the U.S. or Canada, and WestJet.

text: Taqpachana, awiyun apnaqirinakampiw sarañatak qillqantapxit sasin jawst'as chiqak aruskipt'añama.
eng_text: In all cases, you must book by phone directly with the airline.
